newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Trade in LightPar begins on Sao Paulo bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trade in LightPar begins on Sao Paulo bourse.

text.p: Trade in Brazil's LightPar began on the Sao Paulo bourse after an auction of 1.91 million shares this morning for 291,657 reais, a bolsa spokeswoman said.
LightPar, a unit of federally owned power firm Eletrobras, was the investment arm of former Rio de Janeiro state power firm Light, until the state utility it was privatized in May.
The base price for the shares was set at 150.00, and the shares were auctioned for 152.70 per lot of 1,000 shares. There were 11 accepted purchases during the auction.
The shares fell back slightly to 151.00 reais at 1140 local time/1040 EDT, the bolsa said. The share's symbol on the Sao Paulo bolsa is LIP.
